facts.text: The hotel opened on the Bund in 2009.
facts.excerpt: Opened on the historic Bund in 2009

facts.text: The address is No. 32 The Bund, 32 Zhongshan Dong Yi Road, Shanghai.
facts.excerpt: No. 32 The Bund 32 Zhongshan Dong Yi Road Shanghai 200002

facts.text: The hotel sits at the far end of the Bund, on the western bank of the Huangpu River.
facts.excerpt: The Pen occupies a prime spot at the far end of The Bund, a little curve, a mere eyelash of a street on the western bank of the Huangpu River

facts.text: The hotel is 42.1 km from Pudong Airport and 16.8 km from Hongqiao Airport.
facts.excerpt: 42.1km / 26.1 miles from Pudong Airport 16.8km / 10.4 miles from Hong Qiao Airport

facts.text: The hotel pairs Art Deco-inspired interiors with contemporary comfort.
facts.excerpt: harmonises exquisite Art Deco-inspired interiors with contemporary comfort

facts.text: The Schindler Group produced a replica of a 1930s antique lift, originally housed in the Belgian Lift Museum in Brussels, for the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Schindler Group specially produced this replica of an antique lift from the 1930s, originally housed in the Belgian Lift Museum in Brussels, for The Peninsula Shanghai.

facts.text: The replica antique lift runs from the basement to the second floor.
facts.excerpt: Guests are invited to experience a unique piece of history, as the lift works from the basement to the second floor of the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel owns four Extended Wheelbase Rolls-Royce Phantoms, six BMW Peninsula Editions and a seven-seat Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, all finished in Peninsula Green.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Shanghai owns four bespoke Extended Wheelbase Rolls-Royce Phantoms, six BMW Peninsula Editions, and a seven-seat Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, all finished in signature Peninsula Green.

facts.text: An airport greeting service at the aerobridge can be arranged on request.
facts.excerpt: Airport greeting service at the aerobridge can be provided upon request.

facts.text: The Rosamonde Aviation Lounge celebrates the history of aviation in China with a collection of antiques and memorabilia, including a life-size replica of the Leoning at its entrance.
facts.excerpt: The Rosamonde Aviation Lounge celebrates the fascinating history of aviation in China and, with its impressive collection of antiques and memorabilia, including a life-size replica of the Leoning at its entrance

facts.text: The glass-encased Rosamonde Aviation Lounge is on the 14th floor with views of the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the 14th floor of the hotel, the glass-encased Rosamonde Aviation Lounge boasts spectacular views of the glittering city skyline.

facts.text: Rooms look over the forecourt, the Bund or the Pudong skyline.
facts.excerpt: views overlooking the forecourt, the historic Bund or Pudong skyline

facts.text: Deluxe River Rooms have views of the Huangpu River and the Pudong skyline.
facts.excerpt: The bright and airy Deluxe River Rooms have unparalleled views of the Huangpu River and the ever-changing skyline of Pudong.

facts.text: Deluxe Garden Rooms look towards the historic Garden Bridge across Suzhou Creek.
facts.excerpt: Deluxe Garden Rooms offer a soothing green vista of trees, looking towards the historic Garden Bridge across Suzhou Creek

facts.text: Deluxe Terrace Rooms have private outdoor terraces.
facts.excerpt: The private outdoor terraces are perfect for breakfast or an intimate evening meal from the legendary Peninsula In-Room Dining menu.

facts.text: The Astor Suite has a 115 sq m terrace with a private whirlpool tub and views over the Bund and the Huangpu River.
facts.excerpt: This suite also features a 115 sq m (1,238 sq ft) terrace with a private whirlpool tub and stunning views over the Bund and the Huangpu River.

facts.text: The Palace Suite has a 1,098 sq m terrace, which the hotel describes as the largest private terrace on the Bund.
facts.excerpt: Palace Suite - with a 1,098 sq m (12,000 sq ft) terrace, which is the largest private terrace on the Bund

facts.text: The Palace Suite's wrap-around terrace has a marquee for all-weather entertaining.
facts.excerpt: features a marquee for all-weather entertaining - the wrap-around terrace with spectacular views along the Bund

facts.text: Yi Long Court serves Cantonese cuisine and holds one Michelin star.
facts.excerpt: Cantonese - One Michelin Star

facts.text: Yi Long Court holds two Michelin stars.
facts.excerpt: The hotel’s two-Michelin-starred Yi Long Court is widely held to be among the best Cantonese restaurants in the city.

facts.text: Sir Elly's Restaurant serves Northern Italian cuisine high above the Bund, with views across the Bund.
facts.excerpt: Set high above the Bund, Sir Elly’s pairs a more contemporary expression of Northern Italian cuisine with expansive views across the Bund

facts.text: Chef Eugenio Cannoni of Sir Elly's draws on his Piedmont heritage and a commitment to seasonal ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Chef Eugenio Cannoni works from his Piedmont heritage, reinterpreting tradition with a lighter touch, a more defined perspective and commitment to sourcing seasonal ingredients.

facts.text: Sir Elly's wine list has over 400 labels.
facts.excerpt: Sir Elly’s wine list offers an impressive selection of over 400 labels

facts.text: Sir Elly's Terrace is a rooftop bar on the 14th floor.
facts.excerpt: Sir Elly’s Terrace, on the 14th floor, has some of the finest views of any rooftop bar in the city

facts.text: TAKIYA SHANGHAI is the first international outpost of TAKIYA, a Japanese tempura restaurant.
facts.excerpt: TAKIYA SHANGHAI is the first international outpost of Japan’s legendary tempura restaurant, TAKIYA.

facts.text: TAKIYA was founded in Tokyo in 2014 by Chef Tatsuki Kasamoto.
facts.excerpt: Originally founded in Tokyo in 2014 by Chef Tatsuki Kasamoto

facts.text: The Compass Bar serves classic cocktails and creative bar fare.
facts.excerpt: Classic cocktails and creative bar fare

facts.text: The indoor heated swimming pool has an Art Deco fireplace.
facts.excerpt: indoor heated swimming pool, complete with an Art Deco fireplace

facts.text: The pool area is clad in navy blue and white tiling, with doors to the outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: The pool and surrounding area, with doors to the outdoor terrace, are clad in intense navy blue and white tiling.

facts.text: Hotel and spa guests can have light meals and breakfast poolside or on the outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: Hotel and Spa guests can enjoy light meals and breakfast poolside, or on the outdoor terrace

facts.text: The Peninsula Spa holds a Five-Star rating from Forbes Travel Guide 2026.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Spa is awarded the prestigious Five-Star rating from the pioneering Forbes Travel Guide 2026

facts.text: The spa's decor recalls the 1930s Art Deco period, in navy and ivory tones with dark wood floors.
facts.excerpt: with a bold step back to the look and feel of the 1930s Art Deco period. Soothing tones of navy and ivory perfectly complement dark wood floors.

facts.text: The spa's Thermal Suite has a steam room with aroma mist and shaved ice for cooling.
facts.excerpt: Aroma mist is sprayed into the Steam Room to the glow of an iridescent light feature, with shaved ice for instant cooling.

facts.text: The Peninsula Spa covers over 1,250 sq m.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Spa is over 1,250 sq m (13,455 sq ft)

facts.text: Personal trainers are available at the Fitness Centre.
facts.excerpt: Professional personal trainers are at guests’ disposal to offer expert advice and guidance at The Fitness Centre

facts.text: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult at the pool.
facts.excerpt: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

facts.text: Guests must be 12 or older to use the fitness facility.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be 12 years of age or older in order to utilise the fitness facility.

facts.text: All indoor areas are non-smoking and the hotel no longer offers smoking guest rooms.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Shanghai is no longer able to offer smoking guest rooms, and all indoor areas including restaurants have been designated as non-smoking areas.

facts.text: Single-use items such as combs and toothbrushes are not provided in guest rooms; they can be requested from Spa Reception.
facts.excerpt: Please do not hesitate to contact the Spa Reception should you require any of these items or further assistance.

facts.text: The hotel's owner is Sir Michael Kadoorie.
facts.excerpt: The hotel’s sentimental value to owner Sir Michael Kadoorie is immense.

facts.text: Sir Michael Kadoorie's forebears came to Shanghai from Baghdad in the mid-19th century.
facts.excerpt: His forebears came to Shanghai from Baghdad in the mid-19th century.

facts.text: The hotel was on the Conde Nast Traveler Gold List in 2018, 2019 and 2024.
The hotel calls itself a beacon of luxury hospitality with world-class services.
facts.excerpt: is a beacon of luxury hospitality on the city’s iconic riverfront promenade

facts.text: The hotel says it is the only luxury hotel in Shanghai with a customised car fleet.
facts.excerpt: The only luxury hotel in Shanghai with a customised car fleet

contradictions.note: p3 (official dining page) says Yi Long Court has one Michelin star; p9 (Conde Nast Traveler) says two Michelin stars

sources.excerpt: The hotel’s two-Michelin-starred Yi Long Court is widely held to be among the best Cantonese restaurants in the city.
